hits.snippet:
Over the next 12 months, the FCA has the following specific aims in this area:

## Simplifying Regulation

The report further reiterates the FCA’s recognition that the regulatory framework for insurance has, in certain areas at least, become unduly burdensome and complex. In 2026, the regulator is committed to simplifying rules and data requirements, reducing unnecessary burdens on firms and, ultimately, finding an appropriate balance between growth and consumer outcomes. [...] ## Introduction

On 24 February 2026, the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) published its first Regulatory Priorities report for the UK insurance sector. With the introduction of this new annual publication, which replaces the numerous, individual portfolio letters historically published, the FCA is aiming to make its expectations clearer, more predictable and easier for firms to navigate. [...] Expanding access to insurance is another central priority for the FCA in 2026, with a particular emphasis on supporting vulnerable consumers who are not able to access appropriate products for an affordable price.
